titulo: Taking the bag before they ask
caption:
Taking the bag before they ask

Taking the bag before they ask.

People often turn help down when it is offered as a question and accept it when it simply arrives.

For whoever takes the heavy bag without a word.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text on screen except the last card, with music. A kitchen. A small brick red block figure with white eyes leans on the left beside a heavy paper bag with narrowed eyes and a small tremble. A ink-black figure on the right sees it and walks over. The red one stands up straight, its eyes go wide and then happy and it pulses. The black one takes the bag and they walk to the right together, the bag between them, and the black one smiles. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
